about.text:
Chapter Spitalfields is the tallest student accommodation in London, rising 33 storeys high. The residence offers a variety of room types, including studios, en-suites, and 2- and 4-bedroom flats. All Chapter Spitalfields student accommodations are fully furnished with modern facilities, providing luxury living, great comfort, and privacy. Situated in a prime area of London's financial district, students can enjoy breathtaking views of London's skyline, experience the vibrancy of the City of London, and admire iconic landmarks such as The Shard. The property is within easy reach of top universities, including Coventry University London Campus, INTO City, and Queen Mary University of London. Liverpool Street Station is just a 5-minute walk away, providing quick access to Central London and many other universities. Additionally, Spitalfields Market, Petticoat Lane Market, the trendy Brick Lane, and the historic Truman Brewery are all nearby, allowing students to enjoy an authentic London lifestyle right outside their door.

What Makes Chapter Spitalfields Student Accommodation Special?

Chapter Spitalfields student accommodation is dedicated to offering students a premium and high-quality living experience. Residents enjoy access to a wide range of facilities, including a cinema room, karaoke room, gym, study areas, and more. On the 33rd floor, there is an open-air terrace with unparalleled panoramic views of London. For those who prefer an indoor space, there is also an indoor lounge on the same floor, offering sweeping views of the city and direct access to the bar on the 32nd floor.

 

The 33rd floor also has spacious and quiet study areas—no need to rush to the library for a seat anymore! You can study while enjoying views of London's skyline. Just one level down, the 32nd floor offers a stylish lounge surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass windows, overlooking the skyscrapers of the City of London. Adjacent to the lounge is a bar serving a wide variety of food and international cocktails. On the ground floor, there is a large social space, perfect for weekend gatherings or afternoon tea with friends.

 

In addition to study and social areas, the building provides a gym with balance and wellness classes, so students can stay active and relaxed after studying. There is also a private cinema for movie nights, karaoke rooms for music lovers, and even a fantastic games room to ensure that life at Chapter Spitalfields apartment is never boring. It's also a great way to meet like-minded friends.

What Room Types Are Available at Chapter Spitalfields London?

All rooms at Chapter Spitalfields London are designed in a hotel style, with a modern, clean, and minimalist aesthetic. Each unit comes with a private bathroom. Shared apartments have communal living and kitchen spaces.

The main room types include Apartments and Studios:

  • Apartments: Available in 2-bed, 4-bed, or shared options. Includes communal kitchen and living areas.
  • Studios: Available in Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, and Loft categories. Differences depend on floor, size, and additional services (e.g., breakfast, kitchenware, bedding).
  • En-suites: Bronze and Silver Ensuite options.
  • Twin Rooms: Loft Twin Studio, Bronze Twin Ensuite.
  • Private Apartments: One-Bed Apartment and Two-Bed Apartment.

Transport and Surroundings

Chapter Spitalfields accommodation is in a prime location with excellent transport connections. By tube, you can easily reach the West End, Tower Bridge, and other London landmarks. St. Paul's Cathedral and the City are within walking distance.

Nearby amenities include Tesco, Marks & Spencer, Boots, and Sainsbury's, covering all daily shopping needs. Trendy Shoreditch and Brick Lane are also very close, making it an ideal place for young people to live.

  • Liverpool Street Station: less than a 5-minute walk, connecting you to anywhere in London.
  • Coventry University London Campus: 3 minutes' walk.
  • Newcastle University London Campus: 1 minute's walk.
  • Cass Business School, City University London: 8 minutes' walk.
  • London Metropolitan University: 20 minutes' walk.
  • King's College London: 20 minutes by tube.
  • Queen Mary University of London: 15 minutes by tube.

Safety and Services at Chapter Spitalfields London

Located right next to a police station, Chapter Spitalfields London offers 24/7 reception and security, ensuring residents' safety at all times. The building is equipped with CCTV surveillance and supported by professional management and maintenance teams, available 24/7.

 

Chapter Spitalfields property offers superfast 200MB Wi-Fi throughout the building, so students never have to worry about slow connections or interrupted streaming. Other services include parcel collection and regular KICKSTART London events, introducing students to entrepreneurs and business leaders in the city—an excellent resource for those looking to build a career in the UK.

How to Book a Room at Chapter Spitalfields London Student Accommodation?

With just 3 simple steps on uhomes.com, you can secure your room at Chapter Spitalfields London. First, select your preferred room while reviewing its price, tenancy details, and availability; next, you can reserve an in-person or virtual tour if desired; and finally, complete your booking online with assistance from our property manager.

policy_text.text:
Cancellation Policy

To secure your Room prior to 31st July, you must do the following within 3 days of receipt of this Tenancy Agreement (these 3 days being known as the "Decision Making Period"):

1. Pay your Holding Fee (which will be deducted off your first instalment of Rent if your booking is not cancelled).

2. Both the Tenant and the Guarantor must sign the Tenancy Agreement.

If you have not paid the first instalment of Rent on the date of booking, this must be paid on or before 31 July, otherwise, we reserve the right to cancel your booking.

For bookings made after 31st July, to secure your Room you must do the following within the Decision Making Period:

1. Pay your first instalment of Rent.

2. Both the Tenant and the Guarantor must sign the Tenancy Agreement.

A Holding Fee will not be required for bookings made on or after 1st August.

Failure to secure your Room within the required timescales may result in the cancellation of your booking by us.

Cancelling within the Decision Making Period

The Holding Fee is refundable if you provide us with notice of your intention to cancel within the Decision Making Period. If you cancel your booking after the Decision Making Period but prior to 31st July, any advance payment of Rent will be refunded to you less your Holding Fee, which will not be refunded.

Taking no action throughout the Decision Making Period

If at the end of the Decision Making Period you have taken no action, i.e. not signed and accepted your Tenancy Agreement and/or not paid your Holding Fee and/or your first instalment of Rent then your offer will be cancelled on our system and your Room will be made available for someone else to book.

Cancelling on or after 1 August after accepting your Tenancy Agreement and having paid your first instalment of Rent

To request to cancel your booking outside of the Decision Making Period on or after 31st July but prior to the Tenancy Start Date as set out in the Tenancy Agreement, you must meet any of the following criteria:

1. Your application for a visa has been declined. Please note that this does not include situations where your visa has been granted and subsequently withdrawn.

2. You have failed to obtain your grades to study at university and as such do not have student status.

(the "Cancellation Criteria")

If you meet any of the above Cancellation Criteria and can provide us with evidence demonstrating that you meet the above criteria, your request for cancellation will be granted. If you have already accepted your Tenancy Agreement and paid your first instalment of Rent at the date your cancellation request is granted, we will refund you the first instalment of Rent less any Holding Fee paid (or an amount equivalent to the Holding Fee if you booked your room after 31st July).

If you need to cancel your booking outside of the Decision Making Period on or after 31st July but prior to the Tenancy Start Date as set out in the Tenancy Agreement after accepting your Tenancy Agreement and having paid your first instalment of Rent but cannot meet the above Cancellation Criteria you will remain liable in full for the Rent for the full term of the Tenancy Agreement. This is unless a suitable replacement tenant can be found by you, acceptance of which will be at our sole discretion. Please note that we will not agree to a replacement tenant unless all outstanding accounts with us are settled.

Any decision made to release you from your Tenancy Agreement for any reason that does not fall within the Cancellation Criteria is made by us, at our sole discretion on a case by case basis.

After the Tenancy Start Date as set out in the Tenancy Agreement, requests for room moves or for us to accept a replacement tenant to take over you tenancy will be managed based on availability and at our sole discretion. An Administration Fee of £50 will be payable in each instance if agreed to by us and you will be responsible for cleaning the room in accordance with the terms of the Tenancy Agreement.

Requests for replacement tenants received after 1 June within the Tenancy Period will not be accepted.
